search_budget: Exactly eight sequential component fits: frozen A and B plus six C configurations; exactly fifteen inference alternatives. No extra fits or seed search.
component_seed_rule: Reset all RNGs to the same requested base seed before each stochastic fit

A.normalization: Training-only mu and global s2; Z=(X-mu)/sqrt(s2)
A.solver: CPU float64 Cholesky; (H K H + 3 I) dual = y - training_mean(y)
A.stopping: one direct solve; verify residual; no epochs

B.architecture: SequenceRegressor from local network.py, unchanged initialization
B.checkpoint: strict best global original-scale validation R2, restored

averaging_scale: original efficacy; invert B standardization first; no clipping
selection: Maximum global original-scale validation R2; exact ties: fewer constituents, then A alone, then shallower C depth and larger l2_leaf_reg. No validation fitting of averaging weights.
cnn_checkpoint_selection: B standalone R2, never ensemble score
gpu_policy: Set torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(min(1.0, (7*1024**3)/torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory), device=0) before CUDA allocation. Log any OOM; reduce batch size rather than budget.
validation_use: selection only, no fitted weights, calibration or preprocessing
status: architecture fixed; full training and final selection pending

C.feature_scaling: raw engineered fixed scales; no learned normalization
C.stopping: Maximum 3000 trees, patience 200 validation RMSE rounds; best tree count restored. On a fixed validation label vector, minimum global RMSE is equivalent to maximum global R2. No neural epoch limit on trees.
